arithmetic: for every ordinary-tail miss, scan Type I normal certificates with m=3 (mod 4) through gap_cap and strict reverse lifts; retain lifts whose square surplus has support at most one, factor each source, then minimize by (least non-core terminal prime, support, surplus, B, gap, source), stopping safely once terminal prime 2 occurs
scope_note: A finite target-side terminal-factor optimization. The q=2 early stop is exact because 2 is the least possible terminal prime; this does not prove a uniform terminal-prime bound beyond the stated box.
